items.headline: [US Feature Stocks] Albemarle reaches tentative wage agreement with union day before Chilean strike
items.snippet: Albemarle reached a tentative wage agreement with Chilean union leadership on the final day of negotiation talks ahead of a strike. If ratified, the risk of a prolonged supply disruption from a major lithium source will be resolved.

items.headline: Market Chatter: Lithium Miners' Profits Surge as Battery Storage Demand Drives Prices Higher
items.snippet: Lithium producers from China to Australia has seen profits soar as unrelenting demand from the energy storage sector pushes prices higher. US-headquartered Albemarle (ALB) noted that global lithium demand grew 45% through May this year, significantly outstripping supply.

items.headline: Albemarle's Lithium Math Turns Brutal
items.snippet: JPMorgan now expects lithium prices to remain in the low-$20-per-kilogram range and expects Q3 adjusted EBITDA of $668 million, down from $858 million in Q2. Albemarle faces delays at the Greenbushes CGP3 plant following a June fire; shares were down 5.16% at $134.21.

items.headline: Albemarle to Benefit From Low-cost Assets, Brownfield Opportunity, RBC Says
items.snippet: RBC Capital Markets said Albemarle will likely benefit from its low-cost assets, brownfield opportunity, and continued focus on earnings improvement in Specialties. RBC has an outperform rating and decreased the price target to $157 from $166.
